description: Given a company website domain, returns a compact company card: the business name and the page element it came from, a generic role contact address (info@, sales@, support@ ...) only if the site publishes one, never a personal address, and the names of up to 10 technology platforms the site runs. Same scrape and evidence check as /scrape, without the evidence detail, at half the price. Free prompt-injection scan included. Not charged if the page cannot be used or no business name is found. Costs $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, no scheme or path, e.g. mailchimp.com

title: Company card from a website
